quick_skim.title: Automated Verification of Hamiltonian Simulation by Quantum Signal Processing
quick_skim.abstract: We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first fully automated verification framework for QSP-based Hamiltonian simulation. Our framework exploits the structure of the simulation algorithm: Hamiltonians are given as weighted sums of Pauli strings, embedded into larger unitaries through block encodings, and transformed into time-evolution operators by quantum signal processing (QSP). Using a symbolic Pauli-sum semantics for ancilla-indexed circuit blocks, our verifier proves that the distinguished all-zero ancilla block is proportional to the target Hamiltonian and infers the subnormalization factor automatically. It then verifies the QSP layer by extracting the implemented polynomial transformation and certifying its approximation error. This structure-aware abstraction is essential for scalability. Composing our verified block encoding and QSP wrapper yields an estimated macro-expanded size of about 1.52 million gates. The verifier certifies the block encoding once and checks the QSP layer through its abstract interface, without expanding the oracle calls. Our implementation verifies block encodings of structured Pauli-sum Hamiltonians with up to 256 system qubits and verifies QSP Hamiltonian-simulation instances by extracting their implemented polynomials and checking the resulting approximation bounds. These results show that fully automated verification can handle common Hamiltonian-simulation circuits at substantial scale when it exploits their algorithmic structure.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 量子信号处理实现的哈密顿量模拟缺乏可靠的形式化验证手段，电路层面的正确性难以保证。作者提出首个全自动验证框架，用符号化的泡利和语义处理含辅助比特的电路块，自动证明块编码正比于目标哈密顿量并推断归一化因子，再从QSP层提取所实现的多项式变换并验证其逼近误差。该工作为哈密顿量模拟、块编码与量子信号处理等基础算法的资源与正确性分析提供了可复用的验证工具。

quick_skim.title: Hardware-Friendly Estimation of LCU-Based Expectation Values via Quantum-to-Classical Workload Shifting
quick_skim.abstract: Estimating the expectation value of an observable $O$ for a quantum state evolved under a general, possibly non-unitary, operator $A$ is a fundamental task in quantum simulation, chemistry, and variational algorithms. Existing linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) approaches implement $A$ on hardware, requiring ancilla qubits, controlled unitaries and, in randomized variants, fresh circuit executions for every Monte Carlo sample. These costs are prohibitive on NISQ and early fault-tolerant devices. We propose HERMES (Hardware-Efficient Reusable Measurements for Estimating LCU-based expectation valueS), which moves the processing of $A$ entirely to the classical domain. Expanding $A$ and $O$ in the Pauli basis and sampling pairs of Pauli terms classically, HERMES rewrites $μ= \mathrm{Tr}(OAρA^{\dagger})/\mathrm{Tr}(AρA^{\dagger})$ as a ratio of weighted sums of Pauli expectation values on the unmodified state $ρ$, with no ancillas, controlled unitaries, or quantum implementation of $A$. A two-level measurement reduction scheme (Pauli deduplication and commuting-group partitioning) bounds the number of distinct measurement settings independently of the sample count, unlike randomized LCU methods whose circuit executions grow linearly with it. On ground-state energy estimation of $\mathrm{H}_2$ and $\mathrm{LiH}$ via imaginary-time evolution, HERMES matches or beats Pauli single-ancilla LCU baseline using shallow circuits with no two-qubit gates beyond state preparation under qubit-wise commuting grouping. It is also more robust to noise and completes a noisy $\mathrm{LiH}$ simulation infeasible for the baseline, at the cost of classical overhead growing with the number of Pauli terms in $A$.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: HERMES shifts LCU processing of non-unitary operators to the classical side by expanding operators in the Pauli basis, reducing ancilla and sampling costs for expectation-value estimation on near-term quantum devices.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对现有线性组合幺正LCU方法在量子硬件上实现非幺正算子成本高、需大量辅助比特和重复采样的问题，本文提出HERMES框架，将算子A与可观测量O在Pauli基展开，并把A的处理转移到经典端。该方法使LCU型期望值估计更适用于NISQ和早期容错设备，减少逐样本电路执行开销。其意义在于为非幺正动力学量子模拟提供硬件友好的LCU评估途径。
